Job Purpose :

To lead the Digital Lifestyle and Loyalty portfolio and partner ecosystem across gaming, streaming, consumer ICT, value-added services, and loyalty. The role develops commercial propositions, manages strategic partners, and improves customer engagement, ARPU, and incremental revenue beyond core connectivity.

Main Responsibilities :

• Define the Digital Lifestyle and Loyalty strategy, portfolio roadmap, and commercial priorities aligned with Mobile Business targets.
• Source and manage strategic relationships with technology, content, gaming, lifestyle, and loyalty partners.
• Develop commercial models and negotiate revenue share, customer benefits, co-marketing support, service levels, and contracts.
• Coordinate proposition design, segment alignment, technical integration, partner onboarding, and launch readiness.
• Monitor adoption, engagement, ARPU, revenue, cost, service quality, and partner obligations, then drive improvement actions.
• Scout emerging trends, incubate beyond-telco propositions, and recommend portfolio expansion, renewal, or exit.

Requirements :

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Digital Media, Information Systems, or a related field; a master’s degree is preferred.
• Minimum 10 years in digital partnerships, business development, loyalty, digital content, product, or commercial management in telecommunications or a consumer industry.
• Having a certification on Strategic Partnerships, Digital Strategy, Loyalty Management, or Commercial Negotiation certification is preferred.

Employment Status:

Permanent (P)

wo-jpfa-JR4989.d:
PT Japfa Comfeed Tbk Unit Sragen

Posisi : Heavy Equipment Operator

Uraian Tanggung Jawab :

1. Melaksanakan kegiatan harian produksi pakan sesuai dengan SOP dan instruksi kerja.

2. Melakukan tugas-tugas rutin seperti penanganan bahan baku, pengoperasian mesin, pengemasan, dan pembersihan.

3. Senantiasa menjaga standar keamanan, kualitas, kebersihan, serta keselamatan kerja dalam produksi pakan.

4. Memantau dan melaporkan adanya ketidaksesuaian pada proses, kualitas, atau peralatan.

5. Mencatat data operasional harian sesuai ketentuan. Mendukung kegiatan tim untuk memastikan kelancaran operasional produksi pakan.

Persyaratan :

1. Pend D3 Mesin, Mekanik

2. Memiliki Sim A (SIO Operator Alat Berat)

3. Pengalaman min 1 Tahun (Fresh Graduate diperbolehkan melamar)

4. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift

5. Siap menerima tugas tambahan yang dibutuhkan dalam team

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

wo-klbf-JR26_000098.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Perform routine production tasks as assigned, ensuring adherence to schedules and standards.
- Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues to minimize downtime.
- Maintain production records and documentation, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
- Assist in the preparation of production reports, highlighting key performance indicators (KPIs).
- Support the implementation of production improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
- Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory standards.
- Coordinate with maintenance teams to ensure equipment is properly maintained and operational.

- Melaksanakan tugas produksi rutin sesuai dengan yang ditugaskan, memastikan kepatuhan terhadap jadwal dan standar.
- Memecahkan masalah teknis untuk meminimalkan waktu henti.
- Memelihara catatan dan dokumentasi produksi, memastikan akurasi dan kelengkapan.
- Membantu dalam persiapan laporan produksi, menyoroti indikator kinerja utama (KPI).
- Mendukung implementasi perbaikan produksi untuk meningkatkan efisiensi dan mengurangi biaya.
- Memastikan kepatuhan dengan standar keselamatan, kualitas, dan regulasi.
- Berkoordinasi dengan tim pemeliharaan untuk memastikan peralatan dipelihara dan berfungsi dengan baik.

Company:
KF PT. Kalbe Farma Tbk.
